text.tspan: Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.

Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account; JWT authentication under Section 5.2.1. Reports without images proceed normally (A2). UC-34 specifies neither an exact initial status value nor an image upload API. FeedbackAttachmentService is a proposed separation of attachment persistence, not an additional SRS feature.
[client-side validation detects invalid details / attachments — Section 5.2.2]
[required information is missing or the content reference is invalid — E1]
[an attachment violates the file rules — E2]
[optional images are attached — UC-34 NF5 / A2]
[the report and attachments are saved successfully]
[the report or attachments cannot be saved — E3]
1: Open Send Feedback / Report a Bug
51: Display an error; do not report
